title: Regina D NDE 5354
content: I can remember being underwater and fighting the wave that had sucked me under. The next thing I remember is being completely relaxed and feeling serene. I have a photographic memory so I can remember seeing the green water clearly, and that I was moving in a circle with the wave. I was told later that after the wave washed me ashore, people moved me away from the water and my aunt performed CPR on me. My out of body experience occurred from this location on the shore. My point of view was not from where my body was; instead, I was next to my body facing my parents. My parents were standing behind my body. I must have turned around. I did not turn to look at them; it is just naturally what I saw. It is difficult for me to describe what I saw. My view bobbed up and down as if I were floating. It didn't look like a color, or a black and white, video. There were bits of color but the lines between colors were not totally clear. It was almost like a fuzzy picture with the different colors floating and bobbing around. There was a lot of commotion and noise that seemed to be muffled. I believe the muffled noise was all the living people standing around me (there were a lot of them). Above the muffled noise, I heard loud and clear a woman scream, ‘NO! SHE'S TOO YOUNG!’ Although I have no evidence who shouted, I have a strong belief it was my deceased grandmother. This event occurred at her beach house, which is where she had died. I am certain it was not my parents screaming, because I could see them standing completely still, mouths dropped, in shock. Suddenly and without warning, I was pulled from this location (floating next to my body) back into my body. I say that I was pulled because it was not a decision I had made. I was literally sucked back into my body by an unknown force (possibly, because my aunt had successfully performed CPR). When I returned to consciousness, I immediately looked to my parents who were standing behind me. My father was still standing completely still, mouth dropped, in shock. Four men were holding my mother back because she was screaming and trying to come at me.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Next to my body on the shore, facing my parents; view bobbed up and down as if floating.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Pulled/sucked back into body by an unknown force, possibly because CPR was successful.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Pulled underwater by a wave; CPR performed after being washed ashore.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Underwater struggle followed by relaxation/serenity; heard a scream believed to be deceased grandmother.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Visual perception described as fuzzy with unclear boundaries between colors; muffled commotion/noise with one voice heard loud and clear ('NO! SHE'S TOO YOUNG!').
